annotations.title: How many independent bets, and where the risk sits

description:
How many independent bets a portfolio's holdings make, from how their prices moved together
        rather than how many tickers there are, and each holding's share of the risk beside
        its share of the money, over the full record and recent years. Shares of the risk
        are Euler contributions and add up to 100%. Typical questions: 'Am I really
        diversified?'; 'Which of my holdings is behind most of the risk?'; 'Do my four funds
        move as one?'. Instead: for the companies inside the funds, look_through. For
        everything at once, measure_portfolio. It does not recommend, predict or calculate
        tax.

base.description: Currency code every figure is expressed in: USD, EUR, GBP, CAD… Default USD.
base.title: Base

holdings.description: What is held: {ticker: number}, 1 to 100 holdings. Weights in any scale (60/20/20 or 0.6/0.2/0.2) or money amounts in the base currency (60000/20000/20000): `units` says which; without it, holdings adding up to 1 or 100 are read as percentages, anything else as money, which makes the falls come out in money. Tickers as the exchange lists them (VOO, VWCE.DE, EQQQ.DE, XAW.TO; 'CASH.USD' for cash). Example: {"VTI": 60, "VXUS": 20, "BND": 20}.
holdings.title: Holdings

units.description: What the holdings' numbers are: 'money' (amounts in the base currency) or 'weights' (percentages or fractions). Omitted: holdings adding up to 1 or 100 are read as percentages, anything else as money, and the answer says so.
units.title: Units

name: portfolio_structure

outputSchema.description: How many independent bets the holdings add up to and who carries the risk.

_fence.description: What these figures are and are not: descriptive, no forecast, no advice. Repeat its sense when presenting the result.

data.description: Where the prices came from and what was missing or repaired.

as_of.description: Last date of price history used.

missing.description: Tickers with no usable history (left out).

standins.description: Holdings measured through a stand-in with longer history: ticker, proxy, index, from, until, evidence.

effective_bets.description: Effective number of independent bets (from correlations, not the ticker count).

max_risk_contribution.description: That holding's share of the risk, 0 to 1.

max_risk_ticker.description: The holding carrying the largest share of the portfolio's risk.

max_weight.description: Its share of the money, 0 to 1.

recent.description: The same figures over the recent years only.

top_factor_share.description: Share of the movement explained by the single strongest common factor.
